Unavailable component (contract rule 7, replacing web L15/26/37/48 lazy DOM-component loaders): createUnavailableWidget(name) keeps the web LazyExoticComponent<ComponentType<WidgetProps>> component shape (so the registry stays renderable + faithful) but resolves via Promise.resolve to a native View+AppText surface that renders an explicit '{name} unavailable' caption with an accessibilityLabel '{name} is not yet available in the native app'. The four Climate* web widget components are not yet ported into web-parity, so a copied lazy import would reference non-existent modules and break typecheck; the explicit unavailable state is the native-safe substitute. Precedent: the already-ported web-parity hook ../hooks/useDashboardLayout.ts documents that the web WidgetDef's lucide icons and lazy components are DOM/bundle concerns and inlines a size-only projection.
